title: Report: Panthers rookie WR Chris Brazzell to have season-ending knee surgery

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Panthers rookie WR Chris Brazzell to have season-ending knee surgery
sources.description: Word on Wednesday was that Panthers rookie wide receiver Chris Brazzell would miss up to eight weeks after tearing his LCL during practice, but his absence from the field is set to be even longer.
